title: Back Pain and Fatigue

rationale.SPEP / Immunofixation / UPEP: M spike, monoclonal Ig. Bence Jones protein.

hpi: {{patient_name}} presents with persistent back pain (pathologic vertebral compression fractures), fatigue (normocytic anemia), and possibly hypercalcemia. Multiple myeloma is a malignant proliferation of plasma cells in bone marrow → monoclonal immunoglobulin (M protein) production. Classic CRAB criteria: hyperCalcemia, Renal insufficiency, Anemia, Bone lesions (lytic lesions on X-ray/skeletal survey). Labs: elevated total protein with globulin gap, M spike on SPEP, immunofixation confirms monoclonal Ig (IgG most common), elevated kappa/lambda free light chains with abnormal ratio, Bence Jones protein in urine (UPEP). Bone marrow biopsy: >10% clonal plasma cells. Skeletal survey: lytic punched-out lesions. Treatment: induction (bortezomib + lenalidomide + dexamethasone), +/- autologous stem cell transplant if eligible. Bisphosphonates (zoledronic acid) for bone disease.
